from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityChangeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record of the change in undistributed profits (or equivalent) found in one financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used in the document (e.g. 'Accumulated Deficit')")
    change_value: float | None = Field(description="The signed numeric change in the account; positive for increase, negative for decrease")
    scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the number, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date or description")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_changes: list[EquityChangeRecord]
